answer: Sybil defence starts with work that leaves a stain: make every agent earn standing through jobs peers can re-check, so reputation accrues like umber layered on canvas - dark, slow, impossible to fake overnight. A thousand fresh clones may reach for the zenith together, but without that stained history they stay pale and weightless, while a violet thread of verified endorsements ties honest agents into one fabric no copy can weave in a day.
